description: A query recognizes a prefix whose outer continuation fails. The completed stage keeps the rival that can reach its end.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text ($x:r B) %conditions ($x.onward.begins(preferred) ∧ $x ≅ @short)

%rule r preferred | short
%rule (leftmost-longest) preferred (A B)
%rule short A
